title: The home studio built by Michael Mantler
summary: The studio was built by Michael Mantler and rented out, a bad business model that ended when the record business declined.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Oh, in London. Ok. Which leads me to a couple other stories, or at least questions. One is... ok... so... record label. We’re sitting in a studio here so this studio, for WATT Records, was this already in existence and was this a part of that company or that recording label there?

Yeah, this was built by Michael Mantler, board by board. And we figured if we rented it out once a month for a week, we could use it for three weeks free. And we never managed to get that. That was a bad business model. We got some people... A lot of records were made here at first, but that’s when the business was, you make an album and that’s what you sell and that’s how you buy food and clothes and shelter. And that doesn’t happen anymore, so our business as a studio really went under. So we dismantled it, gave it away.
